summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K, equivalent to a US current report, on September 25, 2026, an open-market buyback of its own book-entry common shares under Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. The company repurchased 100,000 shares on BYMA at an average price of ARS $2,007.63 per share, for a total of ARS $200,763,464, with trade completion on September 28, 2026. The acquisitions did not exceed 25% of the average daily trading volume over the prior ninety business days, and no NYSE purchases were made. No board recommendation or advisor was named; the buyback supports shareholder returns while signaling insider valuation views.
